# telnyx_requirement_groups (Data Source)

Lists requirement groups, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_requirement_group`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_action` (String) Filter requirement groups by action type One of `action`, `ordering`, `porting`.
- `filter_country_code` (String) Filter requirement groups by country code (iso alpha 2)
- `filter_customer_reference` (String) Filter requirement groups by customer reference
- `filter_phone_number_type` (String) Filter requirement groups by phone number type. One of `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `filter_status` (String) Filter requirement groups by status One of `approved`, `declined`, `expired`, `pending-approval`, `unapproved`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `requirement_groups` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirement_groups))
